searchText: Hello everyone, im from Colorado USA and would like to learn more about ETH. Particularly about what to do if I have a bunch of transactions pending, I can’t exactly figure out if this server is for general questions, but I love research (studying entomology right now) so I can’t wait to start reading and learning on here! I would also like to understand how different tokens built on the etherium network operate and how they tie into the ecosystem
